summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of structured meal suggestion flow with food preference feature. All 10 features working correctly: login flow, personalized greeting, mood message sending, food preference selector with 5 buttons, preference selection triggering recipes, time-categorized recipe display (Quick/Moderate/Elaborate), recipe cards with images on right, recipe card details (title, time, difficulty, description, icons), food preference badge in header, and Save Recipe functionality.

issues: Some recipe card titles show section headers like 'Cooking Time:' or 'Difficulty Level:' instead of actual recipe names - this is due to AI response parsing in RecipeMessageDisplay.js

passed_tests: Login flow works and redirects to chat page
Chat page loads with personalized greeting (Hello, Test User!)
User can send mood message (e.g., 'I feel tired and need energy')
Food preference selector appears after mood message
All 5 preference buttons present: Vegetarian, Vegan, Non-Vegetarian, Pescatarian, Any
Clicking preference button sends message and triggers AI recipe suggestions
AI responds with recipes organized by time categories
Quick Option (15-20 min) section displays with recipe count badge
Moderate Option (20-40 min) section displays with recipe count badge
Elaborate Option (40-60 min) section displays with recipe count badge
Recipe cards display with two-column layout (text left, image right ~45%)
Recipe cards show title with cooking time in parentheses
Recipe cards show difficulty badge (Easy/Medium/Hard)
Recipe cards show description text
Recipe cards show clock icon with cooking time
Recipe cards show cuisine icon with cuisine type (e.g., Italian)
Recipe cards have Save Recipe button
Food preference badge appears in header after selection
Food preference badge has ✕ button to change preference
Save Recipe button opens confirmation dialog
Save Recipe dialog shows recipe preview with title, description, complexity, time
Confirm Save Recipe button saves recipe successfully
critical_code_review_comments: RecipeMessageDisplay.js: Recipe parsing regex could be improved to better filter out section headers (Cooking Time:, Difficulty Level:) from being treated as recipe titles

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All food preference flow features working

context_for_next_testing_agent: Food preference flow feature is fully functional. Flow: 1) User sends mood message -> 2) System asks for food preference with 5 buttons -> 3) User clicks preference -> 4) System sends request with preference and time category instructions -> 5) AI responds with categorized recipes (Quick/Moderate/Elaborate). Recipe images use curated static Unsplash URLs (MOCKED - not dynamic image API). FoodPreferenceSelector component has data-testid attributes for all 5 buttons. RecipeMessageDisplay parses AI responses and displays visual cards with images on right side.
